# Taylor & Francis

> > Global academic publisher fostering human progress through knowledge across 2,700+ peer-reviewed journals, books, and open-access research platforms.

Taylor & Francis is a leading international academic publisher serving authors, researchers, educators, librarians, and institutions worldwide. The company operates through multiple imprints including Routledge and CRC Press, offering comprehensive publishing services, peer review management, and research access solutions.

## Key Topics

- Academic Publishing
- Peer-Reviewed Journals
- Open Access

- Journal Editors
- Book Publishing

- Dove Medical Press
- Customer Support

## Publishing Services for Authors

- [Authors](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve/academia/authors): Publishing services for book and journal authors with Author Services support.
- [Journal Authors](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve/academia/authors/journal-authors): Journal publishing services for 2,700+ peer-reviewed journals with open-access options.
- [Book Authors](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve/academia/authors/book-authors): Book publishing services and support for academic and professional book authors.

## Academic & Research Community

- [Who We Serve](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve): Overview of Taylor & Francis customer segments including academia, industry, government.
- [Journal Editors](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve/academia/journal-editors): Editorial support and resources for journal editors managing peer review.
- [Faculty & Instructors](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve/academia/lecturers): Resources and textbooks for faculty and instructors in higher education.
- [Librarians](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve/academia/librarians): Institutional content and library resources for academic librarians.

## Industry & Government Solutions

- [Practitioners](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve/industry-government/practitioners): Professional resources and research materials for industry practitioners.
- [Government](https://taylorandfrancis.com/who-we-serve/industry-government/government): Research access and journal subscriptions for government organizations.

## Regional & Global Operations

- [Taylor & Francis China](https://china.taylorandfrancis.com): Taylor & Francis China regional site serving authors, editors, librarians, and institutions in China.
